app_exercised: Exercised FuelWell running app at http://localhost:3000 across 6+ key routes (dashboard, log, profile, settings, recipes, progress, fitness, daily-review, coach, grocery-list, meal-plan, recovery) on both desktop (1024x768, 1280x800) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Tested form interactions (search input state on /app/log, unlabeled inputs on /app/settings), keyboard navigation (tab order, focus visibility), network conditions, and accessibility features. Captured evidence through Playwright automation detecting zero-dimension nav elements, missing focus rings, truncated text, undersized touch targets, form state loss, missing labels, and messaging tone issues.

findings.description: Mobile nav items render with 0x0 dimensions, invisible/unusable
findings.observed_evidence: Sidebar navigation links on mobile viewport 390x844 show width=0, height=0 pixels; links are completely invisible and untappable
reproduction_steps: Inspect sidebar nav element dimensions with getBoundingClientRect()
Observe width and height are 0 pixels
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure mobile nav links have minimum 44x44px touch targets; add display flex with width constraints to nav items

findings.description: Profile uses 'Lose weight' framing that's inappropriate for pregnant users
findings.observed_evidence: Profile page at /app/profile displays 'Lose weight' as goal option for sample preview user in second trimester context
reproduction_steps: See 'Lose weight' displayed as primary goal option
No context for pregnancy-specific goals like 'Maintain' or 'Gain (healthy pregnancy)'
findings.suggested_fix: Customize goal language based on user context detected at onboarding; hide 'Lose weight' for pregnant users, show 'Maintain' or 'Gentle nutrition' instead

findings.description: Mobile nav items have zero dimensions, not clickable in sidebar
findings.observed_evidence: Dashboard sidebar nav rendered in mobile view shows all links at 0x0 dimensions: FuelWell logo, Dashboard, Log Meal, Coach links all invisible
reproduction_steps: Inspect sidebar nav element bounding boxes
All nav links report width=0, height=0 pixels
findings.suggested_fix: Apply visible width/height to sidebar nav elements in mobile media query; minimum 44px height per touch target guideline

findings.description: Form inputs lack associated labels, ARIA labels, or meaningful placeholders
findings.observed_evidence: Settings page /app/settings contains 5+ form inputs (number type) with no aria-label, no associated <label> elements, and no placeholder text; keyboard and screen reader users cannot identify field purposes
reproduction_steps: Tab through form inputs (height, weight, numbers fields)
Activate screen reader or check DOM for aria-label attributes
No labels found; screen reader announces 'unlabeled input' or 'number input' with no context
findings.suggested_fix: Add aria-label to all inputs (e.g., aria-label='Height in inches') or pair inputs with visible <label for=id> elements

findings.description: Tab order reaches interactive elements in logical sequence
findings.observed_evidence: After pressing Tab twice on /app/log, focus moved to 'Low carb' filter button, indicating tab order is functional and reaches main content
reproduction_steps: Verify focus landed on actionable element (filter button)
findings.suggested_fix: No fix required if tab order remains logical; continue testing to verify all interactive elements are reachable via keyboard

findings.description: CSS includes :focus-visible styling for keyboard users
findings.observed_evidence: Stylesheet inspection shows :focus-visible rules defined; keyboard focus state is styled and available for keyboard navigation
reproduction_steps: Open DevTools Inspector on any app page
Verify focus styles are defined with outline or box-shadow
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure focus outline has 2-3px width and high contrast (100% opacity) for keyboard-only users, especially on mobile

findings.description: Form input loses state when navigating away and back, breaking ADHD workflow
findings.observed_evidence: On /app/log, after typing 'chicken' in search field, navigating to /app/dashboard and back to /app/log, search input is cleared; state not persisted
reproduction_steps: Observe search field is now empty; term lost
findings.suggested_fix: Persist search state in sessionStorage or React context so returning to /app/log restores prior search term and focus

findings.description: Daily review empty state lacks encouraging next-step messaging
findings.observed_evidence: Daily review page /app/daily-review does not provide positive reinforcement or clear guidance for users with incomplete daily logs
reproduction_steps: View day with no meals logged or incomplete recovery checklist
Observe messaging is functional but lacks motivation
findings.suggested_fix: Add encouraging copy like 'Ready to log your first meal?' or 'You're on track—add one more log to close your day strong'

findings.description: Grocery list form should persist partial entries across navigation
findings.observed_evidence: Grocery list /app/grocery-list does not cache partially-entered items; if user navigates away mid-entry, changes are lost
reproduction_steps: Start adding an item: type partial text in item field
findings.suggested_fix: Cache form state in sessionStorage to recover after interruptions; show pending edits visually (e.g., italic or warning icon)

findings.description: Daily review shows encouraging feedback on progress
findings.observed_evidence: Daily review page includes encouraging language ('on track', streak indicators); positive reinforcement is present for motivation
reproduction_steps: Observe messaging for completed days includes encouraging tone
findings.suggested_fix: No fix needed; continue emphasizing progress and streaks for ADHD users who benefit from visible positive feedback

findings.description: Buttons smaller than 44x44px on mobile logging interface
findings.observed_evidence: On /app/log mobile (390x844), action buttons and controls measure 32x32 or smaller, below WCAG 44x44px minimum for motor control accessibility
reproduction_steps: Find buttons with width < 44px or height < 44px
findings.suggested_fix: Increase min-height and min-width to 44px on all interactive elements in mobile layout; add padding if needed

findings.description: No loading skeleton or indicator during page transitions
findings.observed_evidence: Dashboard /app/dashboard loads without visual skeleton loaders or spinners; user sees blank page briefly then instant content render with no transition indicator
reproduction_steps: Open DevTools network throttling (slow 3G or 3-second latency)
Observe initial load state: no skeleton, shimmer, or spinner feedback
findings.suggested_fix: Add skeleton loaders for macro cards, meal history sections during initial page load; show spinner or shimmer effect

findings.description: Buttons smaller than 44x44px on mobile, hard to tap with large hands
findings.observed_evidence: Log page /app/log has 1 of 177 buttons undersized at 32x32px; specific elements like collapse/expand controls fall below touch target minimum
reproduction_steps: Measure button pixel dimensions via inspect
Identify buttons with width or height < 44px
findings.suggested_fix: Apply global min-height: 44px, min-width: 44px rule to all buttons in mobile viewport; add padding to text buttons to meet minimum

findings.description: No visible indicator for offline mode or sync status
findings.observed_evidence: Grocery list /app/grocery-list lacks any 'Offline' badge, connection status icon, or 'Syncing...' indicator in header; user cannot see if changes are saved in spotty network
reproduction_steps: No visual indication of sync status or data reconciliation
findings.suggested_fix: Add subtle connection status badge in header showing 'Offline', 'Syncing (2 items)', or 'Synced' with appropriate icon

findings.description: Progress tracking inputs lack clear labels
findings.observed_evidence: Progress page /app/progress has input field with no visible label, aria-label, or placeholder; user cannot identify field purpose without context
reproduction_steps: Observe unlabeled input field (weight, date, or metric entry)
No associated label element or aria-label attribute
findings.suggested_fix: Add visible <label> with 'for' attribute or aria-label='Enter daily weight' to all input fields

findings.description: Text overflow at 125% zoom on nutrition page
findings.observed_evidence: Navigation and control labels overflow their containers at 125% browser zoom on /app/nutrition; text clips or wraps unexpectedly
reproduction_steps: Observe button or label text clipping, especially macro ring labels
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure flex/grid containers allow text wrapping; test at 125% and 150% zoom to verify no content clips

findings.description: Fitness page uses athlete-appropriate terminology for recovery
findings.observed_evidence: Fitness page /app/fitness includes recovery-focused language ('Recovery', 'Readiness', 'Training intensity') rather than patronizing 'Senior workout' or generic terms
reproduction_steps: Read workout suggestions and recovery messaging
findings.suggested_fix: No fix needed; maintain respectful tone and athlete-appropriate terminology throughout

findings.description: Chart legend labels are too small at standard zoom
findings.observed_evidence: Progress page /app/progress macro breakdown chart legend uses 10-12px text; below recommended 14px minimum for readability
reproduction_steps: Inspect legend text size (Protein, Carbs, Fat labels)
findings.suggested_fix: Increase chart legend font to 14px minimum; test at 125% zoom to ensure readability

findings.description: Week view date headers are clear and readable
findings.observed_evidence: Progress page displays dates in clear format (Mon, Tue, Wed, etc.) in 7-day and 30-day views; headers are readable and use consistent formatting
reproduction_steps: Observe date headers are displayed clearly (e.g., 'Mon', 'Tue')
findings.suggested_fix: No fix needed; date formatting is clear and accessible

findings.description: Goal dropdown and dashboard profile display use 'Lose fat' language, which contradicts pregnant user's health need and invokes diet-culture shame messaging
reproduction_steps: Observe Goal dropdown shows 'Lose fat' as first option
Scroll to bottom of page text
Observe 'Profile context: goal lose' displayed in footer
findings.observed_evidence: Settings page Goal dropdown displays three options: 'Lose fat' | Maintain | Gain muscle, with 'Lose fat' appearing first. Dashboard profile context text at bottom reads: 'Profile context: goal lose, diet none, allergies Shellfish.' The repeated use of 'lose' in prominent locations contradicts P45's actual health goal (healthy pregnancy, not weight loss).
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder goal dropdown to neutral-first: 'Maintain' → 'Lose fat' → 'Gain muscle'. Consider adding pregnancy-aware option like 'Healthy weight gain'. Reframe dashboard profile display to omit or reword goal-specific framing; use goal-neutral language instead.

findings.description: Weight projection widget on Progress page assumes weight loss goal, displaying negative change as success and calculating surplus/deficit incorrectly for gain-focused users
reproduction_steps: Scroll down past calorie/macro trend charts
Read weight values and change projection
Observe 'Preview change: -0.7 lb' and 'Projected time to goal: 7 weeks'
findings.observed_evidence: Weight and goal projection card displays: Start 186.4 lb, Goal 178.0 lb, Preview change -0.7 lb, Projected time to goal 7 weeks. The goal value (178.0) is lower than start (186.4), implying weight loss. For P45 (pregnant, goal is healthy weight gain), this widget shows the wrong direction of change and reinforces 'lose = progress' messaging.
findings.suggested_fix: Make weight projection goal-aware: detect if user's goal is 'Maintain' or 'Gain muscle' and reverse calculation/direction. Change label from 'Preview change' to 'Projected change' with explicit direction indicator (↓ loss / ↑ gain / → maintain). Add contextual helper text for non-loss goals: 'Your target is above your start weight — this is expected for your goal.'
